title: Reading Drill — Sorting a Set of Textile Swatches
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Sorting a Set of Textile Swatches
passages.body:
**A** A costume archive inherited fabric samples attached to cards. Some labels referred to colours now changed by age, so the archivist recorded both the original description and the current appearance.

**B** For related scraps, the weave sometimes gave better evidence than colour. A magnifier helped the archivist see whether threads crossed in the same pattern.

**C** Loose samples were wrapped separately rather than glued to new cards. Their numbers were copied to an index that could be searched by material or date.
